SettingAvailabilityPollMinutesHelpText: How often Requestarr checks on downloads itself, as a backup. At least 5.
SettingAvailabilityWebhookUrlHelpText: The address your media managers use to tell Requestarr a download started or finished. Usually this server's IP address and Requestarr's port. Leave it empty and Requestarr checks on a timer instead.

SettingDiscordAdminRoleIdHelpText: Optional: a role you already have whose members are Requestarr admins, by its ID. Leave it empty and Requestarr makes and uses its own Requestarr Admin role.
SettingDiscordAdminRoleNameHelpText: The name of the role Requestarr makes when no admin role ID is given. The server's owner is always an admin.
SettingDiscordBotTokenHelpText: From the Discord Developer Portal: your application, then Bot, then Reset Token. A saved token shows only its last characters; type a new one to replace it.
SettingRemovalDeleteFilesHelpText: Off: when a removal is agreed, nothing is deleted. It waits in the Queue for you to delete it yourself, then press I deleted it. Turn it on once you trust removals on this server.
SettingRemovalReminderDayHelpText: Which day of that the requester is reminded; 0 for no reminder.
SettingRemovalRequesterTimeoutDaysHelpTe: How long the requester has to answer an admin's removal before no answer counts as yes.
SettingRemovalVoteDaysHelpText: How long a removal vote stays open.
